'''Gawynn Karastee''' was a criminal [[psychiatrist]] who worked in a [[Prison/Legends|penal facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
At some point, perhaps around the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Karastee analyzed the psyche of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], who had been incarcerated in the penal facility. Through several interviews with Zuckuss, she discovered that the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] had a severe case of [[schizophrenia]] and [[multiple personality disorder]]. At the end of her diagnosis, she remarked that Zuckuss was dangerous to himself and others. Karastee's analysis gave little hope that Zuckuss would be released from the facility&mdash;at least willingly. Karastee's report was eventually compiled in a [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species|guide]] to the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
